name: (Zero XOR Subset)-less
description: You are given an array $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ of integer numbers. Your task is to divide the array into the maximum number of segments in such a way that: each element is contained in exactly one segment; each segment contains at least one element; there doesn't exist a non-empty subset of segments such that bitwise XOR of the numbers from them is equal to $$$0$$$. Print the maximum number of segments the array can be divided into. Print -1 if no suitable division exists.
input_specification: The first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the size of the array. The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$).
output_specification: Print the maximum number of segments the array can be divided into while following the given constraints. Print -1 if no suitable division exists.
approach_summary: Formulate linear recurrence as state transition vector V_{n+1} = M * V_n. Compute M^K via binary matrix exponentiation in O(D^3 log K) time.
